notes: G2 wave 5, packet P9d981708aa. Printed: 'Destroy target creature. You may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Liliana, Death Mage, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' I destroy the opponent's creature (it goes to its owner's graveyard), accept the may and search only my graveyard (option 2): Liliana goes from the graveyard to my hand. I did not search my library, so it is NOT shuffled: it keeps its setup order (the runner's six fillers on top, then Keep Two, Keep One). hand after = drawn + Liliana = 2.
